Walk-Through Notes & Next Steps
Hi John! April 30, 2027

I was at the unit yesterday and completed the floor plan (see below — came out great). While I was there I did a thorough walkthrough and photographed everything that's going to need attention before we list. I've organized this report into three categories: paint touch-ups, items left behind, and a few mechanical/functional notes.

The good news: the unit is in solid shape overall. The carpet hall stain largely came up as you mentioned, and the walls just need the usual post-move nail holes patched and touched up. Nothing alarming.

I've got Willie Ayres, my handyman, coming Friday May 1st at 3:00 PM to knock out the paint items and handle a few other small things if necessary. He's great and works fast. He needs to be paid via Venmo or PayPal — I'd like to have you pay him directly for his time since this is make-ready work on the unit. I'll coordinate and supervise; just wanted to flag the payment method so there are no surprises. If you need me to call you before he starts with a time/rate estimate that's cool, just let me know. I'm hoping he'll be able to address everything Friday; if he needs to come back for any reason that's fine too.

Please scroll through, review each item, and let me know if you have any questions or want to handle anything differently. I've also flagged a question about the personal belongings left in the unit — details in the section below.

📦 Items Left Behind — Your Decision Needed
John, there are a number of personal belongings still in the unit that need to come out before we can list. These include framed artwork (the Tintin posters, the large Declaration of Independence print), the step ladder and step stool, the hand truck, cleaning supplies, the cooler on the balcony, and various boxes and packing materials in the bedroom closet. I've photographed and numbered all of these in the report below.

A few options for how we handle this:

Option A — I box and store at my place: I'm happy to carefully pack everything up, transport to my garage, and hold it for your use. You'd give me notice when you want it and I'd arrange a handoff or delivery. Best for keeping momentum toward the listing date.

Option B — You arrange pickup or shipping: If you'd prefer to handle this yourself or have someone else collect the items, just let me know a timeline. Since you're traveling, Option A may be the most practical path for now.

👋 Please confirm your preference

A quick reply with "Option A" or "Option B" — or anything in between — works great. I want to make sure we're aligned before Willie comes Friday and before we schedule the carpet cleaners (Stanley Steamer, $199–$240 as discussed).
